newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb trade deficit seen at $2 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb trade deficit seen at $2 bln - paper.

text.p: Brazil's February trade deficit should hit a record $2 billion according to preliminary figures, a financial newspaper said.
The figure represents the worst monthly trade performance in the history of Brazil, Gazeta Mercantil said.
Exports are estimated at $3 billion, while imports should amount to $5 billion, Gazeta said.
The total deficit for January and February would reach $2.4 billion, almost half the total trade deficit for 1996 which stood at a record $5.576 bln.

A government economic official said the figures were negative, but they would become a thing of the past given that the trade balance registered a surplus of $40 million in the first five days of March, Gazeta said.
Brazil is seen to post a trade deficit of between $8 billion to $9 billion for the whole of 1997.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
